children: Generac announced a long-term supply agreement to provide backup power generators for Amazon data centers, with initial deliveries totaling $2.4 billion expected in 2027 and 2028. In a related transaction, Generac issued a warrant to an Amazon affiliate for up to 1,693,745 shares at an exercise price of $200.9266, with vesting tied to generator purchase volumes up to $8 billion. The structure links commercial growth with equity participation and underscores Generac’s role in supporting Amazon’s expanding infrastructure and resiliency needs.
